posts.name: redlife000
posts.cooked: They left out Proletariat and Friction because they thought the story worked better without have a direct switch of the Vengeful Five and the Freedom Five, and that they thought Blank and Peacemaker would work better for the story they were trying to tell. That's a perfect answer to that question. They've also said they have enough material to return to the inver-i-verse many times over. Laying out the entire Proletariat/Friction story in an editor's note would just get rid of that for later.

posts.cooked:
Another editors note down without my last 2 questions being addressed. It’s enough to drive a man batty.

For those wondering (which I presume at least one person does), I asked about Progeny and why he changed directions, and I asked about the mega spoiler from the legacy supplemental episode and a potential implication it had regarding the Legacy line in general and about Iron Legacy in particular. Pretty sure I sent in both before editors note 18, although I may have missed the question deadline.
